title: Sector Configuration (light contract)
description: Written once per session by the orchestrator (main agent). Sector classification is agent JUDGMENT, not an algorithm: confidence is self-assessed and must be justified. Schemas enforce structure and provenance only.

confidence.description: Self-assessed. Below 0.70 -> fall back to 'standard' and set requires_manual_review=true.

module_file.description: e.g. sector_banking.md, or null for standard

signals.description: Objective evidence the judgment is based on (sector/industry fields, revenue mix, regulatory status, KPIs present).

rationale.description: Why this sector and this confidence.

runner_up.description: Second-best sector hypothesis — forces the classifier to consider the alternative.

disconfirming_signals.description: Evidence AGAINST the chosen sector that was considered and weighed.
